يحتفلون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِلُونَ (yaḥtafilūna) /jaħ.ta.fi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# يُحْتَفَلُونَ (yuḥtafalūna) /juħ.ta.fa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
